desc: This happening bar serves Continental & Indian food while offering DJ'd music & dancing.
addr: 413, 100 Feet Rd, KHB Block Koramangala, Koramangala 4-B Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

rev.t: Dance floor and pubs are there.  Food is just mediocre. Varieties of alcohols, liquor, wines, breezers and soft drinks are available. Smoking is also allowed. Nice party vibe, especially on weekend days. Happy hours are also there. Entry …
Taking about the vibe and music is just not that vibey. Useless remixes and ruined the songs. It was severely overcrowded. …

Great atmosphere. Food is good. Service can (and should) be way better. We went on a Monday and the music was good (albeit too many repeats and rain interrupted the performance but resumed quickly). No power backup is a huge L.
